title: 패션지 공식,
한 번에 요약

segments.label: 올드머니 3규칙
en: Pricey brands? Check the shoulder line first
01 Keep colors calm: navy and grey in one tone
02 Skip logos, show texture: cable knit, flannel, suede
03 Easiest rule: just one accessory, a well-shaped bag
Answer: shoulders, hem, bag. Sources: Harper's Bazaar, W, Vogue Korea

segments.label: 올드머니 두 색 6벌
en: Know two colors and you have the old-money look
Brown & cream: double blazer, suede skirt, cream cropped jacket
Navy & grey: navy blazer, pleated midi skirt, quilted cropped jacket
Formula: one dark color, one light color, gold only on small earrings
Easiest is No. 3: cropped jacket + basic trousers

segments.label: 비 오는 날 집콕 2룩
en: From under the blanket to the corner store, the key is your shoes
Look 1: oatmeal rib-knit set with dusty pink bed socks
Look 2: sage fleece zip-up, charcoal joggers, black rubber clogs
Match top and bottom, one color on socks, wipeable shoes for rain
